mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the upper gut to the colon was most worthwhile: the result clearly showed food staying in the tube while absorbed material crosses its lining.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the eye was straightforward, but the fitting itself added little beyond what its picture and name already suggested.

surprise.text: The model supplied a second eye while fitting the one we built, making the head complete without duplicating the earlier construction.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless: each fitting had a clear location or route. The last skin fitting was the only available combination, though, so it wasn't much of a decision.

continue.text: I might continue to see how the assembled parts work together, although this chapter's mostly predictable fittings weren't a strong hook on their own.
